topPick.thesis: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is trading at 16.0x P/E, a 13% discount to its sector average of 18.4x; RSI at 62 reflects healthy bullish momentum without overextension. Three-month price momentum of +50.3% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +348% year-on-year, underpinned by a bearish MACD signal suggesting near-term caution is warranted. Composite score of 80/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +29.2% over the past quarter.
